name: @pipeworx/mcp-cloudflare-radar

tools.name: internet_quality
tools.description: Internet Quality Index (IQI) summary — bandwidth, latency, jitter, packet loss — current value + change vs prior period. Optionally filtered to a 2-letter location code.

tools.name: attack_summary
tools.description: Layer-7 DDoS attack mix over a time window. Returns the percentage breakdown of attacks by mitigation product or attack vector. Filter by location to scope to a region/country.

dimension.description: Summary dimension: mitigation_product | http_method | http_version | ip_version | bot_class (default mitigation_product)

tools.name: top_locations
tools.description: Top locations by a metric. metric=http_requests returns countries by share of HTTP traffic; metric=dns_queries by DNS; metric=attacks by attack origin. Returns ranked list with share percentages.

tools.name: bgp_leaks
tools.description: Recent BGP route-leak events detected by Cloudflare. Returns leaker AS, victim AS, originated prefixes, start/end times.

tools.name: radar_domain_rank
tools.description: Is this domain widely visited, or nowhere? Returns a single domain's Cloudflare Radar popularity: an exact `rank` for domains inside the global top 100, otherwise only a `bucket` (e.g. "200" = top 200, "100000" = top 100k) — `rank` is null for everything outside the top 100, so do not build logic on it populating. Below Radar's tracked ceiling (bucket ">200000") there is NO signal at all: Radar does not verify domain existence, so a real-but-obscure site and a domain that has never existed come back identically. Read `ranked` and `interpretation`, not just `bucket`, to tell those apart.

domain.description: Domain to look up, e.g. "reddit.com" (no scheme/path).

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a historical ranking snapshot. Omit for the latest.

tools.name: radar_top_domains
tools.description: The most-visited domains on the internet, globally or filtered to one country. Use to see what dominates traffic, or as the reference list to compare a rank against.

date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) for a historical top-list. Omit for the latest.

tools.name: radar_ai_bots
tools.description: Cloudflare Radar AI bots: which AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, ...) generate how much of AI-bot traffic. Returns percentage shares by user agent, by crawl purpose (training, search, user action) or by industry of the crawled sites, over a date range, globally or for one country. Pass user_agent to get a single crawler's share; an unknown user agent returns found:false.

user_agent.description: Only with dimension=user_agent: look up one crawler by name, e.g. "GPTBot".

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cloudflare-radar forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cloudflare-radar pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
